user_saw: Cancelling a Gemini web search could leave it waiting for citation redirects and still cause it to start more requests.
summary: The fix forwards the search cancellation signal to citation redirect requests, aborts active requests and prevents later batches, and preserves the caller’s cancellation reason.
reasoning: The oldest readable Gemini implementation already passed `params.signal` to the search POST while calling `resolveCitationRedirectUrl(citation.url)` without it. I checked the later provider refactor and cache cancellation fix, which left citation requests uncancellable. The offline history is missing a parent at the shallow boundary, so I could not verify when the omission first shipped or whether cancellation had worked earlier.
